say:1:1410214001:1.text: Where are the materials?! Didn't Ironbeard say they'd be here any minute?!
say:1:1410214001:1.source_cn: 材料呢！已经沸腾半个小时了！铁须不是说材料马上就到吗？！

say:2:1410214002:1.text: Ah, here they are! The new batch just arrived, and it's being sorted right now. They'll be in the furnace in no time.
say:2:1410214002:1.source_cn: 来了来了，来了！补充的这批刚刚送过去分拣了，立刻就能下炉。

say:3:1410214003:1.text: Honored envoys, allow me to introduce Hyla, our overseer and chief blacksmith. She's the best in the business. I've never met a forge she couldn't master!
say:3:1410214003:1.source_cn: 各位特使，这就是我们锻造的总负责人海拉，她可是我们技术...

say:4:1410214004:1.text: Hyla, these are the envoys from the Lightbearer Empire. They're here to inspect our work. We're all in order, aren't we?
say:4:1410214004:1.source_cn: 来，海拉，这是从耀光帝国前来视察的特使。咱们的锻造工作...

say:5:1410214005:1.text: Of course, there are no problems here!

say:6:1410214006:1.text: Just don't pull my workers for other tasks, change the schedule, or throw in last-minute requests—then everything'll run fine!
say:6:1410214006:1.source_cn: 只要你别抽我的人去干其他活，别随随便便改排期，别临时提...

say:9:1410214007:1.text: *Ahem* Please forgive her... Hyla has a bit of a fiery temperament, but that's only because she's so passionate about her craft.
say:9:1410214007:1.source_cn: 这、这个，见笑了，海拉她一直就是这个脾气……

say:10:1410214008:1.text: No need to worry. A little temper comes with the territory for top-tier craftsmen. As long as the deadlines are met and the quality is up to standard, we'll be satisfied.
say:10:1410214008:1.source_cn: 没事没事，技术人员脾气大是正常的。只要能赶得上工期，保...

say:11:1410214009:1.text: Of course! As for the deadline... well, I suppose even my reassurances won't set your mind at ease.
say:11:1410214009:1.source_cn: 那绝对没问题！至于工期嘛……口头说估计您也放心不下。

say:12:1410214010:1.text: How about this? Why don't you try out our forging process for yourself? See it firsthand.
say:12:1410214010:1.source_cn: 这样吧，不如来体验下我们这边的锻造流程？

choice_prompt:13:1410214010.text: How about this? Why don't you try out our forging process for yourself? See it firsthand.
choice_prompt:13:1410214010.source_cn: 这样吧，不如来体验下我们这边的锻造流程？

say:14:1410214011:1.text: Yep! We've optimized it all. It's simple to pick up.
say:14:1410214011:1.source_cn: 是的，我们这边已经形成了一套很完善的流程机制。

say:15:1410214012:1.text: Just follow the instructions and manage the heat correctly. Even a newcomer can forge a fine piece.
say:15:1410214012:1.source_cn: 上手非常简单，只要照着要求，控制好火候，就算是毛头小子...

say:16:1410214013:1.text: The final quality is reviewed by specialists before submission so it won't disrupt production.
say:16:1410214013:1.source_cn: 而最终质量则有专人进行审核后才会提交，不会影响到制造工作。

say:17:1410214014:1.text: That's intriguing. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you say we give it a try? Let's see who can forge the sharpest weapon!
say:17:1410214014:1.male: That's intriguing. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you say we give it a try? Let's see who can forge the sharpest weapon!
say:17:1410214014:1.female: That's intriguing. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you say we give it a try? Let's see who can forge the sharpest weapon!
